scenario: [LADP.8.5.2], [LUNI.4.5.1]: a written quantity of another dimension is refused "unless exactly one `implicit` formula bridges the two dimensions, which the compiler then applies". `5_s` is a quantity of `time`, and `hz_period` bridges `time` and `frequency`, so it compiles on a `Hz` kwarg. Its twin, `LADP.8.5.2_written_time_on_another_dimension`, has no formula. This vector compiles the program and does not observe the value the formula gives. PATH PINNED: `dsc.types.luni_8_2_quantity_dimension`, read by `dsc.validate.ladp_8_5_2_written_dimension` for the `bridge_one` arm and by `dsc.rete.luni_4_5_1_call_kwarg`, which applies the formula.
rules_ds:
unit dimension frequency storage float64 base Hz
unit Hz: frequency

unit formula hz_period inverting implicit:
    hz_to_period(x: Hz): nanosecond  = 1e9 / x
    period_to_hz(x: nanosecond): Hz  = 1e9 / x

service tone.set:
    kwarg pitch: Hz required
    no response

schema Trig scope logical:
    v: Int key

rule r:
    Trig
->
    call tone.set pitch: 5_s nocooldown
